Depends on the 20 Years a Cook Quest and on getting the addon items

The {wiki:Draccoon Herald Outfits|Draccoon Herald Outfit} is tied to the {wiki:20 Years a Cook Quest}: completing it unlocks the base outfit. You get the two addons by using two items: the {item:Heralds Wings} (wings) and the {item:Heralds Insignia} (staff). The quest also gives the achievement The Rule of Raccool.
